literal_meaning: তৃণের মতো জ্ঞান করা (grass-like knowledge to regard)
figurative_meaning_en: To disdain; to consider insignificant or worthless
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুর মতামতকে তৃণজ্ঞান করে উড়িয়ে দিল।
এই সিদ্ধান্তকে তৃণতুল্য জ্ঞান করবেন না।
example_sentences_in_english: He brushed aside his friend's opinion, treating it as worthless.
Don't disdain this decision as insignificant.
note: The idiom draws from the idea of grass being trivial and easily discarded, emphasizing undervaluation in Bengali expressive language.
